summary: community.proxmox proxmox_pool_member replaces member with a members list and adds an exclusive parameter for full vs incremental mode.
questions: How do I add multiple members to a Proxmox pool with Ansible?
What does exclusive do in proxmox_pool_member?

answer_card.title: proxmox_pool_member uses a members list
answer_card.answer_md: In `proxmox_pool_member`, the `member` parameter became a **`members` list**, so you can manage several pool members at once. A new **`exclusive`** parameter switches between full mode (the list is the complete membership) and incremental mode.
